behaviors_asserted: Hono class uses DefaultEnv as the default generic type instead of Env.
Provide interfaces DefaultEnv, EnvBindings, and EnvVariables.
Developers can extend DefaultEnv via declaration merging to set Bindings and Variables without specifying Env types when instantiating Hono.
Adapters (example: AWS Lambda) can declare module "hono" to add Bindings like event and lambdaContext.
